Systema_compatible_evaluation.Euclidean_centroid_accuracy: for each predicted post state, find the nearest among all 48 true test post centroids by Euclidean distance; canonical condition breaks exact ties; hit iff nearest condition is the task itself; report mean hit rate
Systema_compatible_evaluation.train_reference: E164 condition-balanced mean of 71 train perturbation-condition centroids

all_required_task_metrics.RMSE_reference_invariance_note: RMSE is unchanged by subtracting a shared reference; retain it to distinguish matching from the 2x matching single-additive amplitude

PRESCRIBE_own_family.confirmatory_gate: point estimate >0 and both task-bootstrap and component-gene cluster-bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds >0
PRESCRIBE_own_family.disclosure: E162 failed its original prediction nondegeneracy gate; E163 is a validation-informed futility diagnostic, not external confirmation
mandatory_sensitivity: same score versus raw 2023-gene Pearson effect accuracy
same score versus PCA10 and raw RMSE with negative expected sign
same score versus strict direction fraction
seeds 3408 and 3409 reported without replacing seed 3407

H1.confirmatory_gate: point estimate >0 and both task-bootstrap and component-gene cluster-bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds >0
H1.name: matching_vs_cellweighted_PCA10_RMSE

H2.confirmatory_gate: point estimate >0 and both task-bootstrap and component-gene cluster-bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds >0
H2.name: matching_SE_risk

forbidden_adaptations: change task set or label order
change score sign after seeing truth
replace an NA correlation with zero
claim E162 validation failure was passed

multiplicity.confirmatory: PRESCRIBE family alpha=0.025 plus fixed-sequence baseline family alpha=0.025; total FWER<=0.05
multiplicity.everything_else: descriptive; report raw and adjusted p-values where defined

predictors.profile_kind: one fixed 2023-gene post-state centroid per test task

primary_truth_and_accuracy.constant_or_weak_signal_rule: Pearson/cosine is NA when either compared vector is nonfinite or has sample std <=1e-12; never fill with zero
primary_truth_and_accuracy.direction_rule: per gene hit iff prediction_effect * truth_effect > 0; prediction or truth equal to zero is a miss

resampling.component_gene_cluster_bootstrap: let K be distinct component genes; sample K genes with replacement; for every sampled gene append all containing test tasks in canonical condition order; a pair can enter twice through its two components

risk_and_selective_prediction.constant_rule: nonfinite, exact unique<2 or sample std<=1e-12 => rho, CI, AURC and coverage contrasts NA with constant_or_nonfinite_baseline
risk_and_selective_prediction.ordering: score descending, canonical condition ascending tie-break

scPerturBench_compatibility.NA_reason: all frozen predictors provide centroids, not predicted cell distributions

split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.TxPert_context: seen-single/unseen-double evaluation requires strong additive/simple baselines; split-half is not a model-performance upper bound
split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.cell_id_source: frozen raw obs index; exact string, no row-number fallback
split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.interpretation: experimental reproducibility benchmark/reference; half-sample noise can make it lower than full-sample reproducibility
split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.normalization: normalize/log1p every cell first; form A and B means independently
split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.partition: sort by (digest_hex, cell_id), assign alternating rows A/B; for odd n, A contains one more cell
split_half_experimental_reproducibility_.small_task_rule: n<4 => every split-half endpoint is NA; do not borrow cells

top20.PCA10_truth_top20: 20 genes with largest absolute PCA10-projected truth effect; exact ties by zero-based E161 selected-gene index
top20.raw_truth_top20: 20 genes with largest absolute raw normalized truth effect; exact ties by zero-based E161 selected-gene index

truth_unseal.control_truth: E161 train-only control_gene_mean; never a test control
truth_unseal.first_action: atomically write and fsync a permanent E165 truth-unseal event binding the E164 interface, manifest, raw identity and runner Git blob
mandatory_truth_outputs: raw normalized 2023-gene task means and effects
train-PCA10 projected/inverse-transformed task means and effects
task cell counts and normalization audit
truth_unseal.normalization: per cell over all 20631 endogenous raw-count genes: log1p(10000*x/library); select the frozen 2023 genes only afterward

raw_identity_and_axes_to_reverify: E160 raw file identity and full byte hashes
